summary: Georgia list entry 'nahunta' (GA 397) in Brantley County. A 2022 Commons photo shows a fire lookout beside US 82 between Hoboken and Nahunta; no source ties the two or describes access.

notes_for_editor: The name nahunta is the list's own label (tower 397 is above 73, so the list says it created the name). The only lead on a physical tower is the Commons photo; its description places a tower beside US 82 between Hoboken and Nahunta, but nothing ties it to the list entry or its coordinates, which were not checked against the town. Photo url is the Commons file page, not the direct image; the direct image URL was not retrieved. Brief elevation_m 19.8 assumes the list's 65 is feet; the page prints no unit, so the story omits elevation. No corrections to the brief's record. Status and access stay unknown; no source describes access.
